title: ChatPreference: a large language model for customer preference understanding in the apparel industry

context_summary: The paper introduces ChatPreference, a large language model designed to understand customer preferences in the apparel industry. It uses a three-stage training framework to improve CP understanding and recommendation. The model is evaluated on multiple metrics and compared with other LLMs.
